messages:
emily: Heads-up: ran into a recurring issue where sessionless streaming (short-lived websocket / http2 streams) loses routing context during hosted/dedicated/private failover. Thread for API + manifest contract ideas.

raj: can you describe the loss mode? is it headers dropped, affinity token mismatch, or model mismatch?

emily: it's a combo: hosted fallback picks a compatible model variant but with different runtime config (tokenizer/byte-pair offsets), so streaming deltas become invalid mid-stream. Example: client opens stream against private (model A v3), runtime moves the connection to hosted model A-v3-quant-shard which yields different tokenization -> output continuity broken.

hugo: that's nasty. two possible surfaces: 1) require strict model-variant checksum matching before allowing cross-hosting continuation, or 2) allow fallback but force a stream reset with “resume token” translation.

emily: proposal: add X-Model-Checksum header that encodes stable semantic fingerprint (sha256 of canonicalized model meta: family, tokenizer_id, vocab_version, sequence_limit, quantization_profile). Runtime must compare checksum from original session and candidate. If mismatch beyond allowed_policy, runtime should not silently continue stream. It should either a) refuse fallback or b) reply with 409 + Resume-Required + candidate-variants list.

raj: nice. header sketch: ```
X-Model-Checksum: 3f7b9c4a...
X-Session-Resume-Version: 2
```
and controlplane will provide human-readable candidate reasons.

hugo: manifest addition idea: spec.fallback.resume_behavior = "fail|reset_opaque|translate" where: fail = prevent cross-hosting continuation, reset_opaque = abort stream and return resume token (client must reconnect), translate = attempt tokenizer translation (experimental). Default = "reset_opaque" for safety.

sec-bot: security note: resume tokens must be short-lived and not contain PII or auth data. Also resume path must validate tenant manifest to avoid cross-tenant leakage.

emily: observability: emit metric fallback.stream_resume.{allowed,rejected,translate_attempted} with tags hosting_from, hosting_to, tenant_id_hashed. Also record last_good_checksum and candidate_checksum in sample traces (not full payload).

raj: runtime implement detail: when migrating a stream, if checksum matches exactly, allow seamless failover. If checksum differs and manifest.resume_behavior=="reset_opaque", runtime returns: 409 {"error":"stream_resume_required","resume_token":"<opaque>"} and closes stream. Client should reconnect with header X-Resume-Token. Controlplane can optionally map resume token to a snapshot of conversation state.

hugo: for translate mode, we need a translation shim which is heavy. mark translate as alpha and opt-in per-tenant. spec.fallback.allow_translation: true/false.

emily: note on billing/SLAs: if tenant allows translate or reset, we should still annotate billing events with final_hosting_mode so customers know when hosted provided responses. Add billing tag hosting.final.

infra-bot: alert: 6420007779 - 3% increase in stream resets after last week's hosted capacity shuffle.

raj: rollout plan: 1) add manifest fields and validation 2) runtime: compute X-Model-Checksum at session start and include on probe/handshake 3) controlplane: expose candidate metadata and resume token service 4) client SDK: handle 409 + X-Resume-Token logic gracefully. Canary on low-impact streaming clients for 48h.

hugo: owners: runtime (raj) for checksum/headers/stream aborts, controlplane (emily) for resume token service and candidate metadata, sdk (hugo) for client behavior and docs.

emily: action items: create RFC doc with checksum canonicalization rules, add manifest PR (spec.fallback.resume_behavior + allow_translation flag), runtime PR for header + 409 resume flow, SDK example for reconnect.

sec-bot: policy: resume tokens must expire <= 5 minutes and be single-use. Audit log entry when token redeemed.

emily: agreed. Also we should avoid adding new PII in telemetry; use tenant_id_hashed.

raj: I'll prototype checksum tooling today and post sample hashes for a few model variants.

hugo: will update JS + Python SDKs to auto-retry on 409 with X-Resume-Token flow.

emily: thanks team. Keeping this conservative will reduce silent degradation. We'll iterate on translation later. :rocket:
